questions.stem: A school app collects students' locations at all times, although it only needs to know whether a student is on campus. Which change best protects student privacy?

options.text: Share the locations with more teachers
options.why: Wider access increases privacy risk.

options.text: Collect locations more often so the data is accurate
options.why: This collects even more personal data.

options.text: Record only whether each student is on campus, not exact locations
options.why: Correct. Collecting only the data needed reduces privacy risk.

options.text: Store the exact locations in a larger database
options.why: More storage does not reduce what is collected.

questions.explanation: Collecting only the data needed reduces privacy risk.
